title: Mandatory reuse-first implementation gate
research_summary: Reuse Git native hooks and npm lifecycle pre-scripts instead of inventing a daemon. The only custom code is a small validator that freezes a research record before implementation and checks file coverage later.

sources.finding: Git natively runs pre-commit hooks and supports a repository-defined hooks directory via core.hooksPath.
npm supports pre<event> lifecycle scripts; a non-zero pre-script aborts the requested lifecycle command.

candidates.name: Git native pre-commit hook + core.hooksPath
candidates.reason: Already installed, dependency-free, blocks commits at the machine layer.

candidates.name: npm predev/prebuild lifecycle
candidates.reason: Blocks local run/build when implementation lacks an approved research token.

candidates.name: Custom background policy daemon/file watcher
candidates.reason: Duplicates Git/npm enforcement, adds process lifecycle failure modes, and is unnecessary.

decision.custom_code: Minimal validator only; no custom daemon.
